entries.text: Withdrew the 33 published TPC-DI results from the corpus: they timed BenchBox-written queries on BenchBox-generated tables and did not measure the TPC-DI workload. The bundle validator now refuses any TPC-DI bundle with "TPC-DI bundles are not accepted while BenchBox reworks TPC-DI.", and the seed workflow no longer runs TPC-DI.
